title: Story Details · Teams
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Story Details · Teams with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner makes up a one-sentence story with three concrete details. The partner tells the story once; the lead recalls the three details. All three details match the story. Form two teams. Each team has four turns; only the lead’s teammates respond or assist. Each success earns the team one point. The higher team score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Story Details, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
All three details match the story.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: All three details match the story.
